svg.text: K6 Loose ware and fast washer — how the mechanisms work
Six looping close-ups. Numbers are the paper estimates of the concept document; nothing is built yet.
1 One tang on everything, gripped above the collar

g.text: jaws close, pins in the holes

svg.text: Every tray, pot, tool and cassette part has the same flat tang.
Conical pins pass through its two holes: a form-fit grip, no
tool changer. The jaws touch only the tang, above the collar.
jaws 20–400 N · 5 kg payload · 93 items, 1 grip
2 A tray is the bench

g.text: the box pours into the tray on the scale
pour over the rim opposite the tang
tray goes to a wash well

svg.text: Food is weighed, washed, cut and moved in bought GN trays on
weigh frames. The chuck carries a tray by its tang and pours
over the far rim; afterwards the tray goes straight to a well.
GN 2/3 and GN 1/3 · S0: 10 kg / ±1 g · ≈ 9 s per grip
3 Pull-down swing press: dicer, slicer, ricer

g.text: pull down; slide cuts each step

svg.text: The tube sits on two bars over the tray. The press pulls down
from under the deck: no drive or seal above the food. One tube
with exchangeable end plates replaces five separate tools.
3 kN, 200 mm stroke · 1 kg diced in ≈ 2 min
4 Double-tang grip: flipping a pan pair

g.text: 2 turn it, lay it on the pan

svg.text: Two vessels rim to rim present their tangs back to back; one
grip clamps the pair. Tilt and spin invert it, so the pancake
lands on the hot disc. No inverter, no clamp actuator.
15 s, 2 grips per flip · same move: unmoulding, tossing
5 Wash well: ware hangs by its tang
The chuck hangs each item by its tang in a fixed slot and lets
go above the coaming; it never enters the wet chamber. Fixed
fans spray between the items; steel leaves at ≈ 75 °C, dry.
3.3–3.5 min, 3.2 L, 0.24 kWh per load · A0 ≥ 60
6 Wash as you go: two wells alternate

g.text: top view of the two wells
one well is always open, the other washes

svg.text: A soiled item goes straight into the open well, its wet parking
place. Full well: lid closes, 3.5 min wash; the other opens.
Clean, hot steel dries itself and returns to its store.
7 loads per meal · 35 L, 2.3 kWh · clean 15–20 min after
